claim.quote: Analyzing data collected over 6.4 years by the effective mass of 61.3 kg, with improved energy calibration and time-dependent background modeling, we found no evidence of an annual modulation signal, challenging the DAMA/LIBRA result with a confidence level greater than 3$\sigma$.

name: COSINE-100 Full Dataset Challenges the Annual Modulation Signal of DAMA/LIBRA

significance.quote: challenging the DAMA/LIBRA result with a confidence level greater than 3$\sigma$
significance.value: challenging the DAMA/LIBRA result with a confidence level greater than 3 sigma

summary.plain: Using all 6.4 years of data, COSINE-100 found no evidence of a yearly modulation signal and says this challenges the DAMA/LIBRA result at a confidence level above three standard deviations.
summary.technical: Full COSINE-100 data set (21 Oct 2016 - 14 Mar 2023; 358.4 kg yr of high-quality data; effective mass 61.3 kg); model-independent annual-modulation test with improved energy calibration and background modelling (Sci. Adv. 11, eadv6503 (2025)).

title: COSINE-100 Full Dataset Challenges the Annual Modulation Signal of DAMA/LIBRA
why_it_matters: The collaboration's final modulation test of DAMA/LIBRA's claim; its authors describe the DAMA/LIBRA modulation as unlikely to be caused by dark matter.
